subject: CS363
filterSummary: Successfully selected 10 videos (5 English, 5 Arabic) across the 5 specified concurrency topics. The selections prioritize direct relevance to the topic and student pain points, with a strong preference for videos with high view counts as a proxy for quality and clarity. For the niche 'Ada Rendezvous' topic, a video on general Ada concurrency was chosen in English, and a video on the broader 'Message Passing' concept was chosen in Arabic due to a lack of specific candidates. One Arabic channel, Mustafa S. Aljumaily, was selected for multiple topics due to its excellent and comprehensive coverage of operating systems concepts.

coverage.note: Only one relevant candidate found for this specific topic.
No videos on 'Ada Rendezvous' found; selected best video on the broader 'Message Passing' concept.
